traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements in docs/stories/025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION.story.md are fully implemented and verified:
- Before-catch annotations are still detected and validated (existing behavior preserved) and now explicitly prioritized when both positions exist. - Inside-catch annotations (as first comments inside the catch body) are detected via getCommentsInside and a line-based fallback scanner, fulfilling REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION and REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC. - Prettier compatibility is validated with real Prettier and ESLint CLI integration tests, covering before-catch moved-inside, initially-inside, and empty catch blocks. - Auto-fix for CatchClause inserts @story/@req inside the catch body at the correct inner indentation, matching how Prettier formats catch comments (REQ-PRETTIER-AUTOFIX). - Rule-level and performance tests confirm no regressions for catch or other branch types. - Rule documentation has a dedicated CatchClause section that explains both valid positions, precedence rules, and Prettier behavior.
Given the concrete implementation, targeted unit tests, integration tests, and documentation updates, this story is fully satisfied.
